name: Mercenary Soul Cleaver
notes: HoH1 Mercenary version of Soul Cleaver (players/warlock/mercenary/soul_cleaver_merc.sval, 16 skill points in the Mercenary skill shop). Against HoH1 level 4 (in brackets): a kill trigger on any kill (Soul Consumption victims spread 50% of damage taken and the debuff on death). Mercenaries bought one fixed version of a class's skill once that class reached level 20 in town; its 'Primary Attack' wording let the class passives work with any weapon.
summary: Enemies you kill have a 25% chance to burst for 20 magical damage nearby; you regain 10% of that damage as health and 20% as mana.
